user.title: MWM Ears room
user.description: Bind this room's infrared hardware. Typically one IR box provides both an emitter and a receiver -- the form suggests them together. Either half can be left unused.

error.need_one: Pick at least one of the two infrared entities.

abort.no_infrared: No infrared emitter or receiver entities are available. Set up an infrared proxy (e.g. ESPHome) first.

set_state.name: Set ears state
set_state.description: Native pair-level control for automations, richer than light.turn_on: sets both ears' exact colors (each ear independently or a single native both pick) plus a room-wide effect in one call. Target any of the pair's lights or the mwm_ears device.

color.name: Both ears color
color.description: Applies to both ears at once (native both form, one transmission) when left_color/right_color are unset: "off", a catalog color name, or a "kind:value" selector.

left_color.name: Left ear color
left_color.description: Exact color for the left ear only (overrides `color` for this ear), leaving the right ear exactly as it is: "off", a catalog color name, or a "kind:value" selector.

right_color.name: Right ear color
right_color.description: Exact color for the right ear only (overrides `color` for this ear), using the verified right-only forms: "off", a catalog color name, or a "kind:value" selector.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: Room-wide effect program run after any color changes. Effects are not per-ear.

select_color.name: Select exact color
select_color.description: Sends one exact catalog color to the ears, bypassing color-wheel snapping so near-identical shades (simple 0x61 blue vs palette 0x04 pure blue) arrive as distinct commands. Takes a catalog name ("lime green", "pure blue") or a selector ("simple:0x61", "palette:4").

color.name: Color
color.description: Catalog name or "kind:value" selector for the exact color to send.
